title: Tabgha campaign: remote endpoint and small local fallback
acceptance: The T03/T04 packs run on Tabgha against the best two Neo Tokyo-3 models over models.remote, with latency and timeouts recorded, including Neo Tokyo-3 asleep
The same packs run locally against qwen2.5:1.5b and qwen2.5:3b (downloaded on Tabgha in this step), recorded with base and model identity
Timeouts and memory pressure on the mini PC recorded, not hidden
privacy: Reports stay private under artifacts/; only metadata (identity, counts, outcomes) enters Git. No prompts, replies or credentials.
escalation: A model campaign runs only inside the scope and budget the owner approved in F-078-T02
A model failure that NERV can fix becomes a B- record with a failing test first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 at the harness 8.5.0 initial step size; campaign wall time on the host is extra and bounded by the T02 budget. Not a measurement.
